names.anatomical: Axial CT slice at the tumour level (donor, normal anatomy)

gloss: A real CT cross-section from the donor this atlas is built from, at the level of the tumour. The donor had no tumour; the tumour is drawn on it as a dashed outline.
role: A CT or MRI scan is used when the lump may reach the deep part of the gland or when cancer is suspected, to show how far it goes and what it touches.
matters: Imaging defines whether a mass is inside the gland or outside it, looks for features of cancer, and checks for spread. For deep-lobe lesions MRI and CT are the modalities of choice. On MRI, a dark signal on T2-weighted pictures and poorly outlined margins point toward malignancy.
